subject: Q3 marketing budget proposal
body: Hi Sam, for Q3 I'm proposing a marketing budget of $250,000. That is about 10% lower than Q2 because overall spend is under review. Let me know if this works for your team.

subject: RE: Q3 marketing budget proposal
body: Thanks Maria. I think $250,000 is too low given the Project Aurora launch in July. We really need $300,000 to support the launch campaign. Can we find a middle ground?

subject: RE: Q3 marketing budget proposal
body: Okay, let's compromise. I have approved a Q3 marketing budget of $280,000. Of that, $50,000 is earmarked specifically for the Project Aurora launch campaign. Please plan accordingly.

subject: Project Aurora kickoff
body: Team, we are kicking off Project Aurora. I will be the project lead. Our target launch date is July 15, 2026. I'll share the detailed plan this week.

subject: RE: Project Aurora kickoff
body: Priya, one risk to flag: the new backend API needs proper load testing. I'd want about two extra weeks of buffer for that before we commit to the date.

subject: RE: Project Aurora kickoff
body: Update: the July 15, 2026 launch date is confirmed. I've booked the load-testing slot Tom needed, and marketing has earmarked $50,000 for the launch tie-in. We are go.

subject: Office move announcement
body: Everyone, we will be moving to the new River Street building on May 1, 2026. More details on packing and desk assignments will follow closer to the date.

subject: RE: Office move announcement
body: Packing instructions: label all boxes with your name. The move happens over the weekend of May 1 to May 2. New desk assignments are posted on the intranet. Please pack by end of day April 30.

subject: Action required: reset your password
body: We detected a phishing email targeting staff. As a precaution, every employee must reset their password by March 20. Do not click links in unexpected emails.

subject: RE: Action required: reset your password
body: Following the incident, multi-factor authentication (MFA) is now mandatory for all accounts. Please enroll using the link on the IT portal today.

subject: Updated PTO policy for 2026
body: Starting this year, the PTO allowance is 22 days per year for all full-time staff. You may carry over a maximum of 5 unused days into the next year.

subject: RE: Updated PTO policy for 2026
body: Quick clarification: any carried-over PTO days expire on March 31. After that, unused carry-over is forfeited, so please plan your time off.

subject: New hire onboarding: Alex Reed
body: Our new analyst Alex Reed starts on April 6. Please make sure a laptop and all system accounts are ready before the start date.

subject: RE: New hire onboarding: Alex Reed
body: Laptop is ordered and accounts will be provisioned by April 3, ahead of Alex's April 6 start. I'll send the credentials securely.

subject: Company all-hands meeting
body: Please join the company all-hands on April 10 at 3:00 PM in the main hall. We'll cover quarterly results and the Project Aurora roadmap.

subject: Parking garage maintenance
body: The parking garage will be closed April 1 to April 3 for maintenance. Street parking is available, or consider working from home those days.

subject: Expense report deadlines
body: Reminder: expense reports are due on the last day of each month and must be submitted through the new expense portal. Late reports may be paid the following month.

subject: Aurora beta testers needed
body: We're looking for internal beta testers for Project Aurora. If you'd like to help, please sign up by March 31. Testing starts in April.
